description: Ministry of Housing & Construction - Publishing of regulations under the provisions of construction Industry Development of foreign contractors
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Construction Industry Development Act, No. 33 of 2014. It establishes legal and regulatory requirements for temporary registration of foreign contractors in the construction industry, including application procedures, fees, and compliance requirements. While it mentions Minister Sajith Premadasa, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title), and the primary content is regulatory/legal framework establishment rather than government personnel or structural changes.
